Hi Olivia and team — thank you for the RFI and for the opportunity to respond. Attached is our consolidated response and evidence bundle. Summary highlights below and details are in the PDF/evidence bundle.

1) NIST AI RMF mapping (summary)\- We mapped the RFI controls to Redwood operational capabilities and artifacts: Identify (model inventory, threat modeling), Protect (access controls, KMS integration, private deployment), Detect (real-time telemetry, anomaly detection on output distributions), Respond (incident runbooks, postmortem cadence), Recover (rollback procedures, model version pinning). Evidence links: SOC2 Type II summary, architecture diagrams, and monitoring dashboards included in the bundle.

2) EU AI Act positioning (summary)\- For Omega Health's intended clinical-assist workflows, we recommend treating the integration as "high-risk" for classification purposes and adopting the corresponding technical and organizational measures. Redwood supports high-risk deployments via Private (VPC / on-prem) and Dedicated modes, tamper-evident logging, and human-in-the-loop tooling for decision review. We included suggested contractual language for HATs (human oversight), attestations, and data minimization clauses.

3) Regression & evaluation approach (executive summary)\- Sampling: stratified sampling by patient cohort, input modality, and prompt template. Metrics: task-specific accuracy/precision, hallucination proxy (factuality checks with confidence thresholds), latency percentiles, calibration metrics, and drift statistics. Regression detection: automated daily regression checks with a rolling baseline; alerts tiered by effect size (e.g., >5% drop in critical accuracy metric triggers immediate canary rollback). Rollback & fallback policy: automated canary to previous pinned model for severe regressions, graceful fallback to deterministic prompt templates for latency/availability events.

4) Artifacts included\- Redwood_RFI_OmegaHealth_20261011.pdf (full mapping and answers)\- evidence_bundle_omega_20261011.zip (SOC2 summary, pen test exec summary, model card, anonymized audit logs, architecture diagrams)

5) Next steps & timeline\- Please review the PDF and let us know any clarifying questions by Oct 15. We are available for a technical session (30–45 minutes) with your security and infra teams; proposed slots are Oct 13–14. If you confirm Private deployment is required, we'll include a deployment-specific runbook and additional evidence about network isolation.
